Instruction Manual - Nikon 50mm AF-S lens 

Brief Product Description

This is the original operational instruction booklet which was sold with the product from new. 

This is the multi language edition so only a few of the pages actually relate to the product written in English - but for those of you who like to keep this sort of thing with your product its a handy thing to have, and of course if you have one to sell it will boost the resale value.

Why not buy to just leave in your kit bag - who knows when you might suddenly need it.

Condition

This is a used Paper-based item so obviously shows some signs of use - having said that it is in very good condition with all pages in good order. 

Will this Manual cover your item 

This booklet is specific to the product shown on the front cover - if in doubt, please ask.

What's Included In The Sale

Manual only.

Additional items are available in my Ebay Shop, please use the "sellers other items" link to take a good look around - thank you.

Posting Arrangements

Wherever possible I aim to post all items the next day after payment. The exception will be for items purchased from Friday through to Sunday, which will be sent on Monday.

UK based purchases - Most manuals will be able to be posted Royal Mail 2nd class large letter post so unless specified otherwise that is the service I will use.  Some listings have options for method / speed / cost, but if your preferred option is not shown please just let me know prior to purchase and if possible I will add this to the listing. 

International / Overseas purchases - These will be sent at the cost shown with the item description.  All import / custom charges will be the buyers responsibility.

I always ensure items are packed safely and securely for transit, and may use recycled packing materials to do so - this helps environmentally and keeps the overall price down for you, my customers.

Returns Policy

Customer satisfaction is important to me, so should you not be happy with your item I offer a two-fold Returns policy as follows:

A. I offer a full refund / replacement for any item found to be faulty upon receipt.

B. I also offer a refund, within 30 days of purchase, for any item returned because the seller decided the item simply wasn't "quite what they wanted". In this situation I will refund the original purchase price, less whatever postage cost I incurred in sending the item to you. The buyer is also responsible for covering the return costs.

In both of the above scenarios, the item should be returned in the same condition it was purchased in. 

And Finally........

Thank you for viewing and hopefully purchasing this item.  I hope to see you back soon - enjoy your photography:)

Item Condition Grade Explained

Grade A+ : Items in excellent condition with virtually no marks or scuffs. Clear lens with no or very minimal dust particles, no marks, no fungus or haze. Full working order. 
 Grade A : Items in great condition with minor marks and/or scuffs. Clear lens with no or minimal dust particles, possible minor marks, no fungus or haze. Full working order.
Grade B : Items in good condition with marks and/or scuffs that are clearly visible. Lens with some dust particles, possible marks to inner or outer elements or other artefacts inside the lens, possible minor fungus or haze that does not affect the use or photo quality. Perfectly usable, Full working order. 
Grade C : Items in fair condition with marks, dings, cracks or minor parts missing and/or scuffs all over that are clearly visible and deeper than Grade B. Lens with dust particles, possible marks to inner or outer elements or other artefacts inside the lens, possible fungus or haze that does not affect the use or photo quality in a major way. Perfectly usable, Full working order, unless otherwise stated. 
Grade D : Items that are sold for parts or as not working. May have any issue described in the above grades. Including missing parts, corrosion, broken parts, dust/dirt or fungus.

CANON EF MOUNT

The Canon EF 50mm f1.8 STM lens is the successor to the incredibly popular 50mm f1.8 mark II and a great addition to any kit bag for anyone looking to take their photography to the next level. Extremely compact and lightweight (160g), the lens features an improved optical design and stepping motor (STM) technology to deliver quicker, near-silent focusing and beautiful images that stand out from their background. Its wide f/1.8 maximum aperture and standard 50mm focal length makes it ideal for a wide variety of photographic genres, including travel, portraiture, documentary, music events, night time shooting and everyday creative snapshots. For use with Canon DSLRs and compatible with full-frame and cropped sensors.


Canon EF 50mm f1.8 STM Key Features:


• NEW Improved optical design (spectra lens coating and a 7-blade aperture)

• NEW Super spectra coating to resist flare and ghosting

• NEW STM focusing motor for quick, near silent focusing

• NEW 7 blade aperture giving better bokeh (soft, attractive blur)

• NEW Minimum focus distance of 35cm

• Fantastic lens for portraits, travel, video and everyday snapshots

• A great performer in low-light conditions

• Super-sharp image quality

• Compact 'go-everywhere' design

• Compatible with full-frame and APS-C

• For Canon EOS DSLRs

Explore creative portraiture and low-light photography

It’s easy to capture superb portraits, or bold, artistic photos and movies with the new lens - the wide f/1.8 maximum aperture provides precise control over depth of field. It gives you the creative freedom to pinpoint focus on your subject and let the rest of the frame blend into a smooth blur - instantly allowing you to draw the viewer’s attention to a specific area. Additionally, the aperture lets more light into the lens, so you can comfortably shoot in darker conditions.


As a prime lens, the fixed 50mm focal length provides high quality results, with enhanced visible sharpness and contrast. When paired with an APS-C EOS DSLR, the lens is ideal for portraiture, helping you capture the perfect head and shoulder composition. It’s also a useful every day 'standard' lens for full frame DSLRs and is great at shooting a diverse range of subjects with a natural viewpoint and perspective.


The lens also provides a minimum focusing distance of just 0.35m, allowing you to get even closer to subjects and achieve a greater level of magnification, while the 7-blade aperture delivers beautiful blur and out of focus highlights. Providing enhanced image quality when compared to its predecessor, the lens features Canon’s Super Spectra Coating, which minimises internal reflections, as well as ghosting and flare.


The perfect addition to any kit bag

The lens has a compact and lightweight design, weighing a mere 160g, and easily slips into your bag adding very little to the overall weight of your kit. The lens’s new external design compliments both Canon’s consumer and mid-range EOS DSLRs, while the new metal mount provides a more robust connection to camera bodies. Additionally, the lens’s manual focusing ring gives you added freedom to control the precise area in focus in your photos and movies.


STM (Stepping Motor)

Canon's new line of STM lenses are specifically designed for shooting video with the camera's Movie Servo AF mode. The first STM lens was released along with the Canon EOS 650D and has been designed to work with the 650D's AF so that they're fast, accurate and silent. The result is a movie that sounds professional without the sound of the noisy AF motor in the background.

detailPayload.description:
Sony E/NEX Fit Pentacon Auto 50mm F/1.8 Bubble Bokeh Meyer Oreston

This fantastic lens can trace it's lineage back to the well regarded Meyer Oreston 50mm F/1.8 and is in effect the same lens with a newer cosmetic design and superior multi coatings on the optics.

This example has been treated to custom brushed aluminium exterior finish.

The 50mm focal length lends itself to portrait work but the lens also makes a great general purpose lens with the fast F/1.8 aperture enabling the user to use shallow depth of field to isolate subjects, an aspect that this lens excels at due to it's attractive rendering of out of focus parts of the image, known as "bokeh" This particular lens is famous for it's Bokeh, with a distinctive look often referred to as "bubble bokeh" or a "painterly" look.

The fast aperture also allows for higher shutter speeds meaning the lens continues to be usable in light levels that would cause slower lenses to succumb to shake induced blurring.

This classic lens really produces gorgeous looking images that are full of character. The bokeh is distinctive, yet smooth, and the mult coated optics allow for high levels of contrast and punchy, vibrant looking colours. 

Built from high quality metals, this lens was made to last and features typically robust German build quality. 

A distinctive and affordable lens that also works great for video work!

This lens comes with a removable Sony E mount adapter allowing it to be fitted to all Sony mirrorless cameras that use the Sony E mount aka NEX mount.
 
The adapter is non destructive and when removed, the lens has a "M42" mount and it can be very easily and cheaply adapted to pretty much any camera available today. I have personally used this lens on my Canon 60d, a Sony NEX-5 and a Panasonic G1 and GH2! There are M42 adapters available inexpensively for the following systems and more:
 
 Canon EOS
 Canon M
 Canon R
 Canon FD
 Canon M
 Contax/Yashica
 Leica R
 Leica M39
 Minolta AF/Sony Alpha
 Minolta MD
 M42 screw
 Nikon
 Pentax K
 Olympus OM
 4/3
 Micro 4/3 system
 C-Mount
 Samsung NX
 Pentax Q
 Nikon 1
 Sony NEX
 Fuji X
 
Adapters are in plentiful supply on ebay, just ask if you require any advice!
 
The lens is a manual optic and hence focusing and aperture must be adjusted manually but the camera will still provide automatic exposure when using AV mode! I recommend using the camera in liveview mode for focusing as you can zoom in and get the focus just right! I even use this manual focusing technique with my autofocus lenses if I have time as it often results in sharper focus than the camera can manage by itself!
 
 
The lens is in very good working condition overall with just normal signs of use and not abuse! A few bits of dust/specks as with any used lens, but no impact on IQ. Fully tested on Canon and Sony cameras and delivering gorgeous looking images. 

Both the focus and aperture mechanisms function correctly.

The lens comes supplied with an M42 to Sony FE adapter and front + rear caps.

Here are some Pentacon sample images to show you the kind of shots you can get:

I take my feedback very seriously and always go the extra mile with my listings, including taking the time to shoot sample photos with each pre-owned lens I sell, so you know exactly what kind of results you can expect!


 
Thank you for looking at this item!
 
If you have any further questions please don't hesitate to ask.
 
Good luck bidders!

This short zoom lens covers a range of frequently-used focal lengths from 18mm wide-angle to 55mm telephoto. The lens structure consists of 14 elements in 10 groups, including 3 aspheric and 1 extra low dispersion elements, and a seven-blade rounded diaphragm.

The linear motor-driven system delivers high-speed autofocus performance of 0.1 seconds to capture those perfect photo opportunities. Silent operation also makes the lens suitable for video recording.

Advanced optical and mechanical designs have been used to keep the lens compact, despite offering fast aperture of F2.8 - 4.0 wide open. It is a fast and highly mobile lens that delivers premium picture quality in a variety of scenes, being suitable for low-light photography or scenes with beautiful bokeh in the background.

It features an OIS (Optical Image Stabiliser) equivalent to 4 stops, controlling the effect of camera shake and preventing blurry shots. The lens is equipped with an aperture ring so that users can easily adjust the aperture while holding the camera up to their eye.

The Canon EF 50mm f1.8 STM lens is the successor to the incredibly popular 50mm f1.8 mark II and a great addition to any kit bag for anyone looking to take their photography to the next level. Extremely compact and lightweight (160g), the lens features an improved optical design and stepping motor (STM) technology to deliver quicker, near-silent focusing and beautiful images that stand out from their background. Its wide f/1.8 maximum aperture and standard 50mm focal length makes it ideal for a wide variety of photographic genres, including travel, portraiture, documentary, music events, night time shooting and everyday creative snapshots. For use with Canon DSLRs and compatible with full-frame and cropped sensors.


Canon EF 50mm f1.8 STM Key Features:


• NEW Improved optical design (spectra lens coating and a 7-blade aperture)

• NEW Super spectra coating to resist flare and ghosting

• NEW STM focusing motor for quick, near silent focusing

• NEW 7 blade aperture giving better bokeh (soft, attractive blur)

• NEW Minimum focus distance of 35cm

• Fantastic lens for portraits, travel, video and everyday snapshots

• A great performer in low-light conditions

• Super-sharp image quality

• Compact 'go-everywhere' design

• Compatible with full-frame and APS-C

• For Canon EOS DSLRs


Explore creative portraiture and low-light photography

It’s easy to capture superb portraits, or bold, artistic photos and movies with the new lens - the wide f/1.8 maximum aperture provides precise control over depth of field. It gives you the creative freedom to pinpoint focus on your subject and let the rest of the frame blend into a smooth blur - instantly allowing you to draw the viewer’s attention to a specific area. Additionally, the aperture lets more light into the lens, so you can comfortably shoot in darker conditions.


As a prime lens, the fixed 50mm focal length provides high quality results, with enhanced visible sharpness and contrast. When paired with an APS-C EOS DSLR, the lens is ideal for portraiture, helping you capture the perfect head and shoulder composition. It’s also a useful every day 'standard' lens for full frame DSLRs and is great at shooting a diverse range of subjects with a natural viewpoint and perspective.


The lens also provides a minimum focusing distance of just 0.35m, allowing you to get even closer to subjects and achieve a greater level of magnification, while the 7-blade aperture delivers beautiful blur and out of focus highlights. Providing enhanced image quality when compared to its predecessor, the lens features Canon’s Super Spectra Coating, which minimises internal reflections, as well as ghosting and flare.


The perfect addition to any kit bag

The lens has a compact and lightweight design, weighing a mere 160g, and easily slips into your bag adding very little to the overall weight of your kit. The lens’s new external design compliments both Canon’s consumer and mid-range EOS DSLRs, while the new metal mount provides a more robust connection to camera bodies. Additionally, the lens’s manual focusing ring gives you added freedom to control the precise area in focus in your photos and movies.


STM (Stepping Motor)

Canon's new line of STM lenses are specifically designed for shooting video with the camera's Movie Servo AF mode. The first STM lens was released along with the Canon EOS 650D and has been designed to work with the 650D's AF so that they're fast, accurate and silent. The result is a movie that sounds professional without the sound of the noisy AF motor in the background.

The wide f/1.8 aperture lets in more than 8x the amount of light compared to the standard zoom lens that is provided with your EOS*. This results in sharper images with less motion blur and reduced need to use flash in dimly lit conditions so you can easily capture the atmosphere of a low light environment.

detailPayload.description:
Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G Full-Frame Normal-Length Prime F-Mount Lens - Black



Hardly used, great overall condition, the optics are clean and clear, everything works perfectly. Comes as shown in the pictures with both original caps and hood. (No original box or manual).



Overview

An essential lens if ever there was one, the AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G from Nikon is the classic normal-length prime featuring a bright maximum aperture and lightweight design. Corresponding to the natural field of view, the 50mm focal length is well-suited for a wide variety of subjects, including everything from landscape to portraiture. The f/1.8 design suits working in difficult lighting conditions and also enables controlling the focus position for using shallow depth of field techniques. One aspherical element is featured in the optical design to minimize spherical aberrations and distortion for high sharpness and accurate rendering. A Super Integrated Coating also suppresses flare and ghosting for improved contrast and color accuracy. Additionally, the Silent Wave Motor affords fast, quiet, and precise autofocus performance as well as full-time manual focus override.

  • Normal-length prime is designed for FX-format Nikon F-mount cameras, however can also be used with DX models where it provides a 75mm equivalent focal length.
  • Bright f/1.8 maximum aperture contributes to both low-light performance as well as offers greater control over depth of field.
  • One aspherical element is used to greatly reduce spherical aberrations and distortion in order to achieve high sharpness, clarity, and accurate rendering.
  • Super Integrated Coating has been applied to lens elements to minimize surface and internal reflections for a marked reduction in lens flare and ghosting.
  • Silent Wave Motor affords quick, quiet, and precise autofocus performance along with full-time manual focus override.
  • Rounded seven-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing bokeh quality.

detailPayload.description:
Sony FE 50mm f/1.8 Full-Frame Lightweight Normal-Length Prime Lens - SEL50F18F



Hardly used, great overall condition, the optics are clean and clear, everything works perfectly. Comes as shown in the pictures with both original caps and hood. (No original box or manual).



Overview

Lightweight Normal Prime

A simple, bright, and lightweight normal-length prime, the FE 50mm f/1.8 from Sony is a versatile lens designed for full-frame E-mount mirrorless cameras. Blending a sleek stature with a versatile focal length, this 50mm prime excels in a variety of shooting situations and the f/1.8 maximum aperture helps straddle an ideal balance between brightness and a compact form factor.


Optical Design

  • One aspherical element is incorporated in the lens design to reduce astigmatism, field curvature, coma, and other monochromatic aberrations.
  • Double-gauss optical configuration helps to reduce field curvature and distortions for more consistent image quality from edge-to-edge.
  • Besides contributing to depth of field control and low-light performance, the bright f/1.8 design also helps to achieve a lightweight and compact profile, making this lens suitable for everyday, walkaround shooting.
  • Rounded seven-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing bokeh quality when employing selective focus techniques.


Autofocus and Physical Design

  • DC actuator motor offers quick, quiet, and accurate autofocus performance to suit both stills and video applications.
  • Minimum focusing distance of 1.5' and a 0.15x maximum magnification suit working with nearby subjects.
  • Metal bayonet offers increased durability and a solid feel when mounting the lens.

Minor wear and tear from previous use, good overall condition, everything works perfectly. Comes as shown in the pictures without any accessories. (No caps, hood, original box or manual).



Overview

Mixing versatility, speed, and a sleek design, the XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 R LM OIS from FUJIFILM is a flexible 27-84mm-equivalent standard zoom for X-mount mirrorless cameras. Its bright f/2.8-4 maximum aperture range suits working in difficult lighting conditions and also helps to keep the overall and size and weight of the lens down. In regard to optics, this zoom features three aspherical elements and one extra-low dispersion element, which help to control spherical and chromatic aberrations in order to improve sharpness and clarity. A Super EBC coating also improves contrast and color neutrality by reducing flare and ghosting when working in strong lighting conditions. Additionally, benefitting use in a variety of situations, a linear motor delivers quick and quiet autofocus performance and a five stop-effective image stabilization system minimizes the appearance of camera shake.

  • Standard zoom is designed for APS-C-format Fujifilm X-mount mirrorless cameras and offers a 27-84mm equivalent focal length range.
  • One extra-low dispersion element is used to greatly reduce color fringing and chromatic aberrations in order to produce high clarity and color fidelity throughout the zoom range.
  • Three aspherical elements control distortion and spherical aberrations, which helps to improve sharpness and realize more accurate rendering.
  • Super EBC coating has been applied to individual elements to reduce lens flare and ghosting for improved contrast and color fidelity when working in strong lighting conditions.
  • A linear motor autofocus system, coupled with an internal focusing design, delivers smooth, near-silent performance that is especially beneficial to video applications and when working in noise-sensitive areas.
  • Complemented by an enhanced gyro sensor and unique series of algorithms, the optical stabilization system minimizes the appearance of camera shake by up to four stops to enable sharper imaging when working with longer focal lengths or slower shutter speeds.
  • Rounded seven-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing out-of-focus quality to benefit the use of selective focus and shallow depth of field techniques.

Please visit our website (the URL is shown in Seller business information below the description) and benefit from free UK next day shipping on orders over £50, 90 days return policy and 6% first order discount with COLINEBAY6 discount code.

 

 

Description
The Tamron 28–75mm f/2.8 XR Di LD Aspherical (IF) is a fast standard zoom lens designed for Nikon F-mount DSLRs. With a constant f/2.8 aperture throughout the zoom range, it’s ideal for portraiture, events, and general photography. The Di designation ensures full-frame compatibility, while XR (Extra Refractive Index) and LD (Low Dispersion) elements enhance sharpness and reduce chromatic aberration. Internal focusing (IF) allows fast, quiet AF and non-rotating front elements for filter use.

Condition

  • Optics clean, no haze, fungus or scratches
  • Autofocus tested and responsive
  • Zoom and focus rings smooth and accurate
  • Mount clean and undamaged
  • Barrel shows light cosmetic wear consistent with age
  • Tested on Nikon DSLR body

Included

  • Tamron 28–75mm f/2.8 XR Di AF lens (Nikon F mount)
  • Front and rear caps 
  • Lens hood 

Collectors Notes
This lens is a popular alternative to OEM fast zooms, offering excellent image quality and a constant f/2.8 aperture in a compact, lightweight package. Compatible with Nikon FX and DX bodies, though autofocus may be limited on entry-level models lacking a built-in motor. A reliable and affordable choice for photographers seeking sharp results and versatile framing.

Key Features

  • Focal length: 28–75mm
  • Maximum aperture: f/2.8 (constant)
  • Mount: Nikon F (Di for FX and DX)
  • Autofocus: via body motor (no built-in motor)
  • Optical design: XR, LD, and Aspherical elements
  • Internal focusing (IF)
  • Minimum focus distance: approx. 0.33m
  • Filter thread: 67mm
  • Aperture range: f/2.8 to f/32
  • Compact polycarbonate and metal construction
  • Made in Japan or China, circa 2003 onwards

SEO Optimised Keywords
Tamron 28–75mm Nikon lens UK, fast standard zoom lens tested, Tamron XR Di LD IF lens, Nikon F mount f2.8 zoom lens, Tamron 28–75mm for FX DX DSLR, Tamron f2.8 lens for sale UK, Nikon compatible Tamron lens UK



Photographs of item

Note that all the photographs are of the item for sale that you will receive. If you notice that the photographs in any way do not match the title or description please contact me and let me know.

Equipment Testing

I will carry out a standard set of testing for all equipment I am selling and will highlight any issues found as well as the perceived condition of the item. Not all tests will be appropriate for a specific camera or lens, but the appropriate ones will be carried out.

  Test 
Digital Camera
  1. Camera powers on with no errors
  2. It is possible to write to memory card
  3. It is possible to  read from memory card
  4. Inspect test image for any noticeable sensor issues
  5. Standard controls/buttons work
  6. LCD screens work and display correctly
  7. The viewfinder is clear
  8. If the camera uses removable lenses, test that lenses mount correctly and functions work.
Film Camera
  1. Test that the camera winds on
  2. Does the shutter release
  3. Test the shutter through all speeds and note whether the speed varies appropriately (speed accuracy not tested or guarenteed)
  4. Shutter curtains open and close as expected
  5. Self timer functions
  6. If the cameras has a light meter that the meter works  and varies appropriately (accuracy of meter not tested or guarenteed)
  7. Condition of the viewfinder
  8. Condition of the mirror 
  9. Rangefinder functions correctly
  10. Bellows condition (specifically looking for cracks and light leaks)
 Lens
  1. Shine a bright light through and check for fungus, haze, dust and scratches
  2. Attach the lens to an appropriate camera body 
  3. Test the function of aperture ( does it open and close appropriately)
  4. Test the function of focus (AF and Manual) 
  5. Function of zoom
  6. Is movement excessively stiff or loose

 

Equipment Grading

Grade Condition
Mint As new condition, no marks, fully working
Excellent very minor usage marks detected, fully working
Very good Some minor usage marks or small scratches, fully working
Good Marks consistent with use, minor wear on edges, small scratches, fully working
Fair Heavier wear marks, possibly some minor issues with functionality, but usable
Poor Heavy wear, not fully working, would require work, should be considered as a renovation project

 

Notes of Condition

Please note the following:

  • All the equipment we are selling is used and unless specifically stated it has not been serviced. 
  • Most older lenses will have some degree of dust.
  • Film cameras will not have had any light seals replaced and they will most likely be degraded, for optimum performance they should be replaced.
  • We will not specifically note individual marks on a piece of equipment, please refer the the photographs.

Shipping

Shipping

The item will be shipped within 2 working days after your payment has been received & cleared. It will often be sent quicker than this.

All items will be sent securely packaged. Please note that although the majority of packing materials we use are new, we will reuse materials when available and encourage all of our customers to do the same.

Items below £150 in value will be sent by Royal Mail 48, those above this value will be sent via Special Delivery in the UK.

We are happy to send internationally.

Returns

All items sold come with a 30 day no fuss return guarantee with the exception of items sold as faulty or for parts.

Sony FE 50mm F1.8 Lens SEL50F18F Full-Frame / Tested & Clean / [Near Mint]

Item Description

 

Product Description

Condition: Near Mint (A-Rank)

This lens is in pristine aesthetic and functional condition. It has been meticulously cared for and shows very little signs of prior use.

  • Cosmetics: Very clean and beautiful. No noticeable scratches, scuffs, or dents on the lens barrel.

  • Optics: Very clear and clean. No fungus, no haze, and no scratches. There is no dust that affects image quality.

  • Functionality: 100% functional. The autofocus is smooth, and all mechanisms work perfectly as intended.

Included Items

  • Sony FE 50mm F1.8 Lens (SEL50F18F)

  • Front Lens Cap

  • Rear Lens Cap

  • Lens Hood

  • Note: Original box and manuals are not included.

Specifications

  • Mount: Sony E-mount (Full-frame compatible)

  • Lens Type: Large-aperture standard prime lens

  • Lens Construction: 6 elements in 5 groups

  • Diaphragm Blades: 7 blades (Rounded)

  • Focal Length: 50 mm

  • Aperture Range: f/1.8 to f/22

  • Minimum Focus Distance: 0.45 m (1.48 ft)

  • Filter Diameter: 49 mm

  • Dimensions (Max. Dia. x Length): 68.6 x 59.5 mm

  • Weight: Approx. 186 g (6.6 oz) — Ultra-lightweight and compact!

Payment & Shipping

We accept payment only through Paypal.
We ship the item worldwide.
 We ship within 1-2 business days after payment is confirmed.
We ship the item via EMS or FedEx. Insurance will be included into the Shipping and Handling fee.
A tracking number will be provided after the item has been dispatched.
It usually takes 3-5 business days to ship to the USA. Delivery time varies by destination and by factors such as weather, custom clearance condition etc.
Please contact the respective post services for more information.
We only ship to your PayPal and Ebay account's registered address.Please make sure that your shipping address is up to date on your PayPal account before placing the order.
If your region couldn't show shipping rate, please contact us for shipping cost and details.
*When using EMS(Japan Post), if the item comes with a battery, the battery has to be inserted into the body for Japan post policy. We will insert the battery into the body before shipping.

Return Policy

Generally, we accept return for exchange or refund within 14 days since the items arrived to your door.
For a full refund, all returned items must be unused, unopened and undamaged in the same brand new condition as it was delivered to you.
If the item does not under the `brand new` condition, we will not be able to make a full refund.
After checking the item and estimating its condition, we will decide the percentage of the refund (80%, 50%, etc).
All packaging, manuals, warranty cards, box and accessories must be sent back with the item.
Please make sure to write "Return Item" on the dispatch slip paper when sending back the item to us.
The item must be sent back via EMS(USPS) or any carrier that provides tracking number..
The buyer is responsible for the items till we receive them.
Please contact us before shipping back the package.
The responsibility of return shipping cost depends on the case.

We deal with return and refund case by case.

Warranty

If you have any warranty problems, we will assist you.
Generally, the warranty is a one year standard warranty and it is valid in Japan only.
Item repairs are carried out by the manufacturers here in Japan.
If your item has a problem, you have to ship your item together with the warranty card back to us.
The item must be sent back via EMS(USPS) or any carrier that provides tracking number.
The manufacturer will decide if the problem is covered by the warranty.
If the problem is not covered by the warranty, extra repairing fee will be charged.
The shipping cost and extra repair fees are the buyer's responsibility.
Warranty cases usually take around 14 business days to be processed in Japan. If it is going to take longer we will contact you.

Warranty scope
Only items that have manufacture defects may be covered by the warranty.
Items that have been damaged from actions such as drops, self repair, non maintenance damage, water damage, damage caused by misuse are out of free repair scope.

FAQ

1)    Can you lower the value in the invoice or mark it as a gift?
-We cannot undervalue the products or mark them as gift/used item, as it is prohibited by the law. Please understand.

2)    What Japan model means?
-It means Japan domestic market model.

3)    Can you send me an English manual?
-English manual can be found and downloaded online.
If you can not find English manual, please let us know.
We will assist you.

4)    Can you check the item/change settings before shipping?
-We cannot do so in order to keep brand new condition.
If you have problems with changing the settings, please let us know.
We will assist you.

5)    Is the item genuine and brand new?
-All our products are genuine and brand new in original boxes. We do not sell fake/used items.

6)    Is the box factory sealed?
-There are items that come sealed by manufacturers. There are also items come unsealed. No matter if the product comes sealed or unsealed, it is brand new and unopened.

7)    What about import taxes in my country?
-Unfortunately we cannot check import tax information of your country from Japan. Please check with your local customs office or contact the post office for more information.

8)    Can you ship via standard registered mail/DHL/etc?
-We ship via EMS or FedEx only.

9)     Can you ship to a different address?
-We can only send to your registered address of Ebay and Paypal. Please keep your shipping address up to date on your PayPal account before placing the order.
 

About Us

　Premium Japan is a professional trading company in electronic business.We have a retail shop in Akihabara, Japan, selling various electronics and Electrical Appliances both domestically and internationally over the internet.
We are dedicated to provide you with high quality items and unmatched service.
We promise our customers that our items are 100% authentic, official products.
We always handle your products very carefully. We never send you poorly-packed products.
You will certainly receive your product in perfect condition.

Premium Japan Customer Support: Monday to Sunday, 10am - 8pm (Japanese Standard Time)
Please keep in mind that we do not work during New Year holidays in Japan.
If you have any questions please feel free to contact us.  Your satisfaction is important to us.
If there are any items you are looking for, please let us know. We will do our best to make sure you are happy with your order!

Sony FE 50mm F1.8 Full Frame E-mount Lens

  • Check Out Our Feedback

A simple, bright, and lightweight normal prime, the FE 50mm f/1.8 from Sony is a versatile normal-length prime lens designed for full-frame E-mount mirrorless cameras. Its sleek design makes it well-suited for everyday shooting, while the fast f/1.8 maximum aperture benefits working in low-light conditions as well as offers increased control over depth of field for selective focus imagery. The optical design incorporates one aspherical element to control spherical aberrations, an employs a double-gauss configuration in order to realize sharper, clearer image quality throughout the aperture range with reduced field curvature. A DC actuator is also employed to provide quick and precise autofocus performance that is also quiet to suit video recording applications. Additionally, a rounded seven-blade diaphragm is featured to render out-of-focus highlights with a smooth, circular appearance. Characterized by its straight-forward design, this go-to lens balances both ease of handling along with enhanced image quality.

detailPayload.description:
SIGMA 24-70mm f2.8 EX DG MACRO ZOOM LENS - CANON EF FIT - USED CONDITION *READ*

In used condition.

This is a fairly old model Sigma lens now, and does show various signs of use. It isn't too bad by Sigma levels, as the "soft touch" type coating/lacquer on these lenses does tend to peel a lot over time. This copy isn't too bad. There are marks and wear, but not too much coating loss. The glass is free from scratches, although if shining torchlight across the front glass there are various small, faint, fine, "cleaning" type coating marks, but these will not affect image quality. There is a decent amount of fine internal dust, but no fungus. At the rear of the lens, and quite hard to spot unless you use a torch, there is some kind of marking behind the rear glass (images 7 and 8). My guess is that this is some kind of age-related balsam-separation where cemented elements can start to have the cement degrade, or start to separate just enough to cause a kind of iridescent, oily marking. This is hard to spot, and had no effect on image quality when the lens was tested.

Please note that this is an older model Sigma lens, one of the first "DG" "Digital Grade" lenses. AF is not as refined as with more modern "HSM" Sigma lenses, and nothing like as accurate and fast as much more modern Canon "STM" type lenses. AF is fairly noisy, and will jump and stutter a bit in it's movement, from one point of focus to another. It is not smooth like a Sigma HSM or Canon USM/STM lens. This is not a fault, but the limitations of an older lens. The better the AF system on your body, the better the results should be from this lens. Test images were taken with a fairly low-spec Canon EOS 100D, and focus accuracy was generally pretty good, but not always perfect.

PLEASE NOTE - MF on this lens worked when tested, but made differing levels of noise, and had occasional grittiness to it. This lens has both an AF/MF switch near the mount, but also a push-pull clutch mechanism using the manual focus ring to engage MF. Even with both set to MF I didn't get 100% consistency in the "feel" of the MF ring. Sometimes it was smooth. Other times when it was tried it was a bit notchy and grittier/louder. It did always work though.

This lens does not have any kind of optical stabilisation.

Sold tested and in working order.

The sale includes all items shown in image 1.....

Lens. Non-Sigma replacement front cap (marked). Canon rear cap. Nothing else is included in the sale.

****A lens hood is not included in the sale.****

This lens will only fit onto and work with Canon EF mount SLR and DSLR bodies. It will not directly fit onto or work with Canon mirrorless cameras, whether M, or RF mount.

Sony FE 50mm F/1.8 Black Lens SEL50F18F F/22 Lightweight 6 elements in 5 groups Travel photography Used from Japan


Description
Overview

The Sony FE 50mm F1.8 is a lightweight full frame prime lens for Sony E mount cameras. It features a standard 50 mm focal length and a bright F1.8 aperture, providing natural perspective with smooth background blur. Its simple and compact design makes it easy to carry, offering reliable image quality for everyday photography.

Specifications
  • Focal length: 50 mm
  • Maximum aperture: F1.8
  • Minimum aperture: F22
  • Lens construction: 6 elements in 5 groups
  • Minimum focus distance: 0.45 m
  • Maximum magnification: 0.14x
  • Filter diameter: 49 mm
  • Dimensions: 68.6 x 59.5 mm
  • Weight: 186 g
Features
  • Bright F1.8 aperture for depth of field control
  • Compact and lightweight design for portability
  • Natural perspective suitable for various subjects
  • Smooth background blur for subject separation
  • Simple construction for everyday use
Use Cases
  • Portrait photography
  • Everyday snapshots
  • Low light shooting
  • Travel photography
  • Beginner to intermediate users

Policy

  • Cancellations & Returns

    Cancellation or returns will be accepted only if the item has an obvious problem that was not mentioned in the listing description. If that, please let us know within 3 days you got the item. Buyer is responsible for shipping costs and any charge incurred shipping products back.Please note that shipping, insurance and handling charges are not refundable.

detailPayload.description:
Sigma EX 70-200mm f/2.8 APO HSM DG OS Lens – Canon EF Mount
Condition: Used – autofocus not working
This is my Sigma 70-200mm f/2.8 EX DG OS lens for Canon EF mount. Optically it’s in good condition with clean front and rear elements, no fungus, no haze, and only light dust as expected for a used lens of this age. There is a spec of internal dust as seen in the glass images. The image stabilisation (OS) works well and the manual focus ring is smooth.
Important: The autofocus is not working. The lens powers on, OS activates, but AF does not drive. I’ve been using it in manual focus only, so please be aware it will need repair if you want full functionality. Because of this, the lens is priced accordingly.
Cosmetically the lens is in decent shape with normal signs of use. Zoom and focus rings turn smoothly but their black colour has faded a good bit, the switches all work, and the mount is clean. Comes with rear glass cap but front glass just has a filter over to protect it. No cap for the front.
This is a great option for someone who wants a fast 70-200 f/2.8 for manual focus work, or for repair, parts, or a project.
Includes:
• Sigma 70-200mm f/2.8 EX DG OS (Canon EF) lens
• Tripod collar
• Rear cap
• Protective filter - please not that the filter can’t be used it’s just in place of the lens cap.
• Sigma Lens carry case
Will be well packaged and posted securely.
Happy to take offers on this!
Any questions, feel free to ask. Cheers!

detailPayload.description:
Condition description:
This lens is in good overall condition and fully functional, displaying minor signs of previous use (see actual photos). The optics are clean and clear. Both auto and manual focus work smoothly. The zoom operates smoothly and transitions seamlessly across the entire focal range. The lens comes with both caps, but does not include the hood, wrapping cloth, original box or manual.


Overview:

Mixing versatility, speed, and a sleek design, the XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 R LM OIS from FUJIFILM is a flexible 27-84mm-equivalent standard zoom for X-mount mirrorless cameras. Its bright f/2.8-4 maximum aperture range suits working in difficult lighting conditions and also helps to keep the overall and size and weight of the lens down. In regard to optics, this zoom features three aspherical elements and one extra-low dispersion element, which help to control spherical and chromatic aberrations in order to improve sharpness and clarity. A Super EBC coating also improves contrast and color neutrality by reducing flare and ghosting when working in strong lighting conditions. Additionally, benefitting use in a variety of situations, a linear motor delivers quick and quiet autofocus performance and a five stop-effective image stabilization system minimizes the appearance of camera shake.

  • Standard zoom is designed for APS-C-format Fujifilm X-mount mirrorless cameras and offers a 27-84mm equivalent focal length range.
  • One extra-low dispersion element is used to greatly reduce color fringing and chromatic aberrations in order to produce high clarity and color fidelity throughout the zoom range.
  • Three aspherical elements control distortion and spherical aberrations, which helps to improve sharpness and realize more accurate rendering.
  • Super EBC coating has been applied to individual elements to reduce lens flare and ghosting for improved contrast and color fidelity when working in strong lighting conditions.
  • A linear motor autofocus system, coupled with an internal focusing design, delivers smooth, near-silent performance that is especially beneficial to video applications and when working in noise-sensitive areas.
  • Complemented by an enhanced gyro sensor and unique series of algorithms, the optical stabilization system minimizes the appearance of camera shake by up to four stops to enable sharper imaging when working with longer focal lengths or slower shutter speeds.
  • Rounded seven-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing out-of-focus quality to benefit the use of selective focus and shallow depth of field techniques.

I’m switching to Full Frame for the moment so there is no point keeping this crop sensor/ APS-C lens. Didn’t get used much so it has been kept nice and dry and I can’t see any dust.

It is very very quiet! Only heard it when I tried it out on a nearby object indoors and so the distance it had to move was greater. Hence restored the original price.

detailPayload.description:
Sigma 24–70mm f/2.8 EX DG – Canon EOS fit

Under the EX DG name, Sigma produced two closely related lenses for Canon EOS:

  1. Sigma 24–70mm f/2.8 EX DG Macro

    • Announced: September 2004
    • Autofocus: screw‑drive (no HSM)
    • Heavier extension and older AF design

  2. Sigma 24–70mm f/2.8 IF EX DG HSM

    • Announced: September 2008
    • Autofocus: HSM (Hyper‑Sonic Motor)
    • Internal focusing, improved AF and mechanics
    • This replaced the earlier Macro version 

Both were sold in Canon EF mount and are fully full‑frame compatible (“DG”).

✅ Where it was made

Manufacturing country: Japan

  • The Sigma 24–70mm f/2.8 EX DG (all EX versions) were manufactured in Japan
  • Sigma officially lists the EX DG HSM version as “Made in Japan”
  • This aligns with Sigma’s long‑standing policy: EX‑series lenses were built in Japan, not outsourced 

You will typically find:

  • “MADE IN JAPAN” engraved on the lens barrel or rear mount area

Canon EOS compatibility

  • Mount: Canon EF
  • Works on:
    • Canon EOS film bodies
    • Canon DSLRs (APS‑C & full‑frame)
  • Autofocus works normally on EOS bodies
  • No electronic compatibility issues typical of early third‑party lenses have been widely reported for this model 

Key specifications (EX DG versions)

  • Focal length: 24–70 mm
  • Aperture: constant f/2.8
  • Optical design: 14 elements (macro version: 13–14 depending on revision)
  • Filter thread: 82 mm
  • Weight: approx. 715–790 g
  • Stabilisation: none (pre‑OS era)
  • Weather sealing: none
LOC: Canon AF Lenses

detailPayload.description:
Canon EF 24-70mm f/2.8L USM Zoom Lens - Poor Condition - Read Description. Lens has been Tested and is fully working. Overall this item is in Poor Condition with some major cosmetic issues.

PLEASE NOTE - Below outlined are the issues, due to Condition this item has been priced significantly lower than market value.

1. As shown in the photos the top metal has some significant dents and damage indicates the lens has been dropped at least once. Causing the lens cap to not Fit properly as shown.

2. The front lens glass does display light scratches all apart from one are not visable under normal daylight only under bright torchlight. The one more noticeable is not deep and still a light surface scratch. None of these show on the photos even when viewed through a computer still good photo quality.

3. Significant paint wear to the writing/ring under the zoom ring as shown, does not affect zoom in any way.

4. Two quiet clicking sounds when zooming around 28-30mm. Doesn't affect zoom or feel of zooming just worth mentioning.

The lens has been Tested and is fully working but bare in mind the issues stated above I'm selling this with full transparency and understanding this is not the best conditioned lens but as mentioned price reflects this.

Mechanically -

The lens is in Fully Working order. Manual focus action is smooth and holds well, lens works perfectly both on Autofocus and manual focus. Zoom ring is smooth and holds well in place for required length. Connects up the the camera and clicks as it should. Clean and clear optics despite scratches as mentioned above. Brilliant lens that takes phenomenal quality photos.


Cosmetically -

The lens is in Poor condition with major signs of wear and tear. Exterior plastic/rubber overall is in not bad condition shows no major signs of scratches, scuffs or cracks it does display some paint wear as described above and light marks or minor signs of wear and tear as expected with a used item please refer to photos. The front glass has Scratches visible under very close inspection under light. The back glass is also in very good condition with no scratches or marks. There is a couple of specks of very fine dust visable under the glass, this does not affect affect photos quality in any way and is not visable on photos, it is only vidable under bight light and very close inspection. No fungus is under the glass at either end. Very clean clear and crisp optics and takes brilliant photos. Comes with Official Canon front and rear lens caps.


If you have any questions please don't hesitate to ask. Feel free to check out my other listings for Photography Equipment, Electronics, Gaming and much more. Thank you for viewing my listing.

Description:

The Fujifilm 18-55mm f2.8-4 R LM OIS XF Fujinon Lens is the standard zoom lens that comes with many the Fujifilm camera bodies as a kit lens - But it's much more than just a kit lens. The term ‘kit lens' has negative connotations that surround it because of other brands that provide lenses that are not sharp, fast or able to capture crisp and detailed images. Fujifilm's ‘kit lens' features a linear motor-driven system that delivers accurate, high-speed autofocus performance of 0.1 second. It also has silent operation making it suitable for video recording as well as stills. Its max f2.8 aperture is fast and can create some beautiful bokeh. This lens is much more than just a ‘kit lens'.

Sharp and Fast

27-84mm (35mm Equivalent)

F2.8 to F4 Aperture Range

Three Aspherical Elements

One Extra-Low Dispersion Element

Super EBC Coating

Linear Autofocus Motor

Optical Image Stabilisation

Rounded 7-Blade Diaphragm

Fujifilm X Mount Lens

Overview:

This lens replaces the previous high quality L-series 28-70mm f/2.8 lens, with a lens of even greater caliber. The range has been extended to cover an ultra-wide angle of 24mm, which makes it ideal for digital as well as film shooters, and the optics are even better than before with two Aspherical elements and a totally new UD glass element. It's now sealed and gasketed against dust and moisture, and a new processing unit makes the AF faster than ever.


Two Aspherical Elements

A lens design incorporating elements ground so the curve of the surface does not describe an arc of a circle. Especially useful in reducing distortion in wide angle lenses.


UD Element

UD glass is one of the new technologies to open new possibilities to develop the zoom lenses with low weight and high optical performance. UD elements make it possible to correct chromatic aberrations whilst maintaining low weight.

original Description

The EF 28-70mm f/2.8L USM has proven very popular with professional and advanced amateur photographers since it was introduced in 1995. However, the increasing use of digital cameras - most having sensors smaller than a 35mm film frame - has increased the demand for a high-performance standard zoom lens with a wider wide-angle setting. The new EF 24-70mm f/2.8L USM lens meets this need. The optical design is based on the previous lens, but incorporates new design features that allow the broader focal length range while maintaining the superb image quality. At the same time, the minimum focusing distance has been reduced from 0.5 metres to 0.38 metres. Improved water and dust resistance ensure that it will become the leading standard zoom lens in the EOS system.

Please Note: This model is now discontinued and a new version is now available: Canon EF 24-70mm f2.8L II USM Lens.

Canon 24-70mm f2.8 L USM Further details: The equivalent focal length would be 38.4-112mm if this lens was to be used on a Canon camera with a cropped sensor. To work this out you have to multiply the focal lengths by the size of the sensor, most non full frame Canon cameras have a sensor size of 1.6. EG 24 x 1.6 (sensor size) = 38.4mm and 70 x 1.6 = 112mm.

Condition description:
This lens is in good overall condition and fully functional, displaying minor signs of previous use (see actual photos). The optics are clean and clear. Both auto and manual focus work smoothly. The zoom operates smoothly and transitions seamlessly across the entire focal range. The lens comes with the original caps, hood and soft lens case, but does not include the original box or manual.


Overview:

This lens replaces the previous high quality L-series 28-70mm f/2.8 lens, with a lens of even greater caliber. The range has been extended to cover an ultra-wide angle of 24mm, which makes it ideal for digital as well as film shooters, and the optics are even better than before with two Aspherical elements and a totally new UD glass element. It's now sealed and gasketed against dust and moisture, and a new processing unit makes the AF faster than ever.


Two Aspherical Elements

A lens design incorporating elements ground so the curve of the surface does not describe an arc of a circle. Especially useful in reducing distortion in wide angle lenses.


UD Element

UD glass is one of the new technologies to open new possibilities to develop the zoom lenses with low weight and high optical performance. UD elements make it possible to correct chromatic aberrations whilst maintaining low weight.

Overview:

Full-Frame Stabilized Standard Zoom

Designed for versatility, the FE 24-105mm f/4 G OSS Lens from Sony is a wide-angle to short-telephoto zoom designed to be an ideal one-lens solution for everyday shooting. The flexible focal length range pairs with a bright constant maximum aperture, impressive optics, and intuitive handling to make it a suitable option for walk-around shooting, street subjects, travel, and event photography.


G Lens Series 

  • Four aspherical elements are featured in the optical design, including two Advanced Aspherical elements, and noticeably reduce spherical aberrations and distortion throughout the zoom range for improved sharpness and clarity.
  • Three extra-low dispersion elements are also used to minimize color fringing and chromatic aberrations for greater color accuracy.
  • A Nano AR Coating has been applied to reduce surface reflections, flare, and ghosting for increased contrast and color rendering in strong lighting conditions. 
  • Constant f/4 maximum aperture offers consistent performance throughout the zoom range and also lends greater control over focus position for shallow depth of field techniques.
  • Rounded nine-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing bokeh quality when employing selective focus techniques.
  • Portable design weighs around 1.5 lb, making this a versatile choice for everyday shooting.


Image Stabilization, AF, and Handling 

  • Optical SteadyShot image stabilization helps to minimize the appearance of camera shake for sharper imagery when shooting handheld with slower shutter speeds.
  • This stabilization system can also be combined with select camera's sensor-shift type image stabilization for more effective control of camera blur.
  • Dust- and moisture-sealed design better permits working in inclement conditions and rubberized control rings benefit handling in colder temperatures.
  • The front lens element features a fluorine coating to protect against smudges and dust from adhering to the glass surface. 
  • Direct Drive Super Sonic wave AF motor and internal focus mechanism provide quick, quiet, and precise autofocus performance and also contribute to more natural, intuitive manual focus control.

detailPayload.description:
Item Description

For sale is a first-generation Canon EF 70-200mm f/2.8L IS USM telephoto zoom lens — the professional-grade L-series workhorse, finished with the iconic red ring. Originally released in 2001 and built in Japan to Canon’s professional standards, this lens remains a benchmark fast telephoto for both stills and motion work. The lens is in excellent condition and has been carefully maintained. It is fully functional: autofocus is fast and responsive via the Ring-type Ultrasonic Motor (USM), and the Image Stabiliser provides approximately three stops of compensation, allowing confident handheld shooting at slower shutter speeds. The glass is clean and free from scratches, haze, or fungus, and the front element has been protected throughout ownership by a high-quality Hoya Super HMC Pro 1 filter (included).

 

The lens uses the Canon EF mount and is fully compatible with all Canon EF-mount DSLR bodies. It also works seamlessly on Canon RF-mount mirrorless cameras (EOS R series) via the Canon EF-EOS R mount adapter, making it an excellent telephoto option for mirrorless shooters who want pro-grade L-series glass at a fraction of the cost of the native RF equivalent. As a professional L-series lens, it features Canon’s dust- and moisture-resistant construction with sealing at the mount and switches.

 

Condition Overview

•       Optics: Clean and clear. No scratches, dust, haze, fungus, or marks on the front or rear elements.

•       Cosmetics: The lens barrel is in excellent condition with only minimal signs of standard use. No dents, paint loss, or brassing on the mount. The rubber zoom and focus rings remain firm and grippy.

•       Mechanics: Both the zoom and focus rings operate smoothly with even resistance. All switches (AF/MF, IS On/Off, IS Mode 1/2, focus distance limiter) click securely into their detents.

•       Image Stabiliser: Tested and confirmed working as intended in both Mode 1 (general) and Mode 2 (panning).

What is Included

This listing includes the complete original setup:

•       Canon EF 70-200mm f/2.8L IS USM lens (Mark I / first generation), serial number 261235

•       Original Canon ET-83II lens hood

•       Tripod Mount Ring B (W)

•       Original Canon padded carrying case

•       Original Canon front and rear lens caps

•       Hoya Super HMC Pro 1 77mm UV protective filter (currently fitted)

•       Original Canon box

Key Specifications

•       Mount: Canon EF (full-frame compatible; works on Canon RF bodies via EF-EOS R adapter)

•       Focal length: 70–200mm

•       Maximum aperture: f/2.8 (constant)

•       Image stabilisation: Approximately three stops, with two modes (general / panning)

•       Autofocus: Ring-type Ultrasonic Motor (USM)

•       Filter thread: 77mm

•       Minimum focusing distance: 1.4 m

•       Weight: Approximately 1,470 g

•       Construction: Dust- and moisture-resistant L-series build

•       Country of manufacture: Japan

Postage and Collection

•       Location: London, UK.

•       Collection: In-person collection is available.

 

Please review the provided photographs to verify the condition of the exact item you will receive. If you have any specific questions about the lens, please send a message, and I will respond promptly.

detailPayload.description:
TPB

Canon EF 70-200mm F2.8 L IS (Image Stabiliser) USM Autofocus Zoom Lens for Canon EOS DSLR

Mechanical Condition : Excellent  - Working Order -  2mm play in lens barrel (common on this model)


The lens mounts smoothly onto the camera and communicates all information correctly.


There is 2mm play in the lens barrel,(common on these lenses) this does not affect performance or images captured.


The zoom is smooth and moves cleanly throughout the full focal range without any resistance or sticking points.


Auto and manual focus is fully operational and smooth from infinity through to close focus. 


The lens exposes correctly through the F stop range.


The selection switches move easily into position and without any resistance.


Optics Condition - Excellent


There is a 1mm mark on the lens coating. It does not affect any captured images.


The optics are clean and the lens is pin sharp.  There are no exterior marks / scratches on the glass, nor any fungus / growth within the inner elements


Cosmetic Condition - Excellent


The rubbers are in excellent condition and not slack, discoloured or sticky ensuring the lens is nice to handle and operate.


The exterior casing is in very good condition, just a few cosmetic marks, these do not affect performance of the lens or images captured


The lettering and model specification markings are clear and not faded


The filter thread is in very good condition, just slight paint loss. A filter, lens cap and hood can be attached


The scale window is clear and the scale is fully visible


-----------------

A superb piece of glass that will capture stunning / unique / sharp images.

-----------------

Please see the photographs attached for a full appraisal of the item for sale. The photographs are of the actual item listed - we do not use stock photographs.

Lens - Supplied with: 


Canon Front (few marks) & Rear Lens Cap
Canon Tripod Collar (few marks)
Canon LZ-1324 Transport / Storage Case (few marks)
Canon ET-86 Lens Hood (marked) - Specifically designed for this lens to ensure optimal performance

------------------

This 70-200mm f2.8L image stabilised EF lens has a newly developed system that can achieve stabiliser effects equivalent to approximately 3 stops in terms of shutter speed. It also features high-resolution, high-contrast optical capability with dust and moisture-resistance, making this one of the most advanced and robust models in its class. 

------------------

Equipment Testing

I will carry out a standard set of testing for all equipment I am selling and will highlight any issues found as well as the perceived condition of the item. Not all tests will be appropriate for a specific camera or lens, but the appropriate ones will be carried out.

  Test 
Digital Camera
  1. Camera powers on with no errors
  2. It is possible to write to memory card
  3. It is possible to  read from memory card
  4. Inspect test image for any noticeable sensor issues
  5. Standard controls/buttons work
  6. LCD screens work and display correctly
  7. The viewfinder is clear
  8. If the camera uses removable lenses, test that lenses mount correctly and functions work.
Film Camera
  1. Test that the camera winds on
  2. Does the shutter release
  3. Test the shutter through all speeds and note whether the speed varies appropriately (speed accuracy not tested or guarenteed)
  4. Shutter curtains open and close as expected
  5. Self timer functions
  6. If the cameras has a light meter that the meter works  and varies appropriately (accuracy of meter not tested or guarenteed)
  7. Condition of the viewfinder
  8. Condition of the mirror 
  9. Rangefinder functions correctly
  10. Bellows condition (specifically looking for cracks and light leaks)
 Lens
  1. Shine a bright light through and check for fungus, haze, dust and scratches
  2. Attach the lens to an appropriate camera body 
  3. Test the function of aperture ( does it open and close appropriately)
  4. Test the function of focus (AF and Manual) 
  5. Function of zoom
  6. Is movement excessively stiff or loose

 

Equipment Grading

Grade Condition
Mint As new condition, no marks, fully working
Excellent very minor usage marks detected, fully working
Very good Some minor usage marks or small scratches, fully working
Good Marks consistent with use, minor wear on edges, small scratches, fully working
Fair Heavier wear marks, possibly some minor issues with functionality, but usable
Poor Heavy wear, not fully working, would require work, should be considered as a renovation project

Designed for versatility, the FE 24-105mm f/4 G OSS Lens from Sony is a wide-angle to short-telephoto zoom designed for E-mount mirrorless cameras. Complementing the useful range of focal lengths is a constant f/4 maximum aperture, which maintains consistent performance throughout the zoom range and also affords increased control over depth of field. Benefitting the reach is an advanced optical design, which employs aspherical and extra-low dispersion glass elements to control color fringing, distortion, and a variety of aberrations for greater sharpness and clarity. A Nano AR Coating has also been applied to suppress lens flare and ghosting for high contrast and color accuracy when working in harsh light.

Further adding to the versatility, this 24-105mm f/4 also incorporates an Optical SteadyShot image stabilization system to minimize the appearance of camera shake for sharper handheld shooting, and this system can pair with select cameras' sensor-shift image stabilization for even more effective blur control. Suiting both stills and video shooting, a Direct Drive Super Sonic wave AF motor, along with an internal focusing design, provides quick and quiet focusing performance as well as natural manual focus control. Additionally, this also features a weather-resistant physical construction, along with a fluorine-coated front element, to enable its use in trying weather conditions.

Overview:

Spanning a popular and versatile range of focal lengths, the EF 24-70mm f/2.8L II USM is a Canon L-series zoom commonly thought of as the workhorse of lenses. Ranging from wide-angle to portrait length, this lens is also distinguished by its constant f/2.8 maximum aperture to benefit working in difficult lighting conditions and to afford greater control over depth of field. The lens is also characterized by its sophisticated optical design, which includes one Super UD element and two UD elements, which reduce color fringing and chromatic aberrations in order to realize a high degree of color accuracy and clarity. Three aspherical elements are also featured, and minimize distortion and spherical aberrations for improved sharpness. Additionally, a Super Spectra coating has been applied to individual elements to control flare and ghosting for high contrast and neutral color fidelity.


Balancing the refined optics, this 24-70mm f/2.8 also sports a ring-type USM and internal focusing mechanism to enable quick, quiet, and accurate autofocus performance, as well as full-time manual focus override. Additionally, this lens is weather-sealed and has a protective fluorine coating on the exposed elements for use in trying environmental conditions.

  • Standard zoom is designed for full-frame Canon EF-mount DSLRs, however can also be used with APS-C models where it provides a 38.4-112mm equivalent focal length range.
  • Bright constant f/2.8 maximum aperture affords consistent illumination throughout the zoom range and also affords greater control over depth of field for working with selective focus techniques.
  • One Super Ultra-Low Dispersion element and two ultra-low dispersion glass elements noticeably reduce color fringing and chromatic aberrations for high clarity and color fidelity.
  • Three aspherical elements minimize spherical aberrations and distortions for improved sharpness and accurate rendering.
  • Super Spectra coating has been applied to individual elements to minimize ghosting and flare for greater contrast and color neutrality when working in strong lighting conditions.
  • A ring-type Ultrasonic Motor (USM), along with an internal focusing design, optimized focusing algorithms, and a high-speed CPU, is employed to deliver fast, precise, and quiet autofocus performance as well as full-time manual focus override.
  • Rounded nine-blade diaphragm contributes to a pleasing out of focus quality that benefits the use of shallow depth of field and selective focus techniques.
  • Protective fluorine coating has been applied to the front and rear element to resist fingerprints and smudges and to make cleaning these elements significantly easier.
  • As a member of the esteemed L-series, this lens is sealed against dust and moisture for working in inclement environmental conditions.
  • Zoom lock lever secures the zoom position at the wide end to maintain a compact form factor and protect the lens when not in use.

detailPayload.description:
Selling my X-E3 with the XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 lens. It’s been well looked after and is in excellent condition. Only 61 frames on the counter.

The X-E3 is a 24MP APS-C mirrorless with the same X-Trans III sensor as the X-Pro2 and X-T2. Compact and rangefinder-styled, it shoots 4K video, has a 325-point AF system, touchscreen, joystick, Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and Fujifilm’s film simulations - Acros, Velvia, Classic Chrome and others. A great street and travel.

There is a tiny bit of paint loss on two of the base feet. That’s genuinely the only thing I can find wrong with it. The sensor is spotless.

The 18-55mm is an incredible lens, not your average kit glass. Super EBC coating, optical stabilisation, f/2.8 at the wide end, and a linear motor for fast quiet autofocus. The glass is immaculate - no marks, haze, or fungus.

Comes with the original box, lens hood, genuine Fujifilm battery, a spare battery, and charger.

Any questions, just ask.

Used Fujifilm X-T20 with XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 R LM OIS

 

The Fujifilm X-T20 with XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 R LM OIS lens is a compact and versatile mirrorless camera kit designed for photographers who want outstanding image quality in a lightweight, travel-friendly system. Featuring a 24.3MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS III sensor and X-Processor Pro, the X-T20 delivers rich colour reproduction, excellent dynamic range, and fast overall performance for both stills and 4K video. Paired with the highly regarded XF 18-55mm f/2.8-4 lens, it offers a flexible zoom range equivalent to 27–84mm, making it ideal for landscapes, portraits, street photography, and everyday shooting. The lens adds fast autofocus with a linear motor, built-in optical image stabilisation for sharper handheld shots, and a bright variable aperture for strong low-light capability. Combined with a retro-inspired, compact body, intuitive physical controls, and a tilting touchscreen, this kit provides an ideal balance of portability, creativity, and professional-level image quality for enthusiasts and advancing photographers.

detailPayload.description:
Fujifilm X-T5 40.2 MP Camera with XF18-55mm F2.8-4 R LM OIS lens GREAT CONDITION

This listing includes the Fujifilm X-T5 camera, XF 18-55mm lens, lens hood, body and lens caps, Fujifilm strap (never used), USB cable, charger & headphone cable. 

This camera is in excellent condition, it is a wonderful kit that creates amazing images (some photo examples included), selling only because I have swapped to the X100VI!!

Please note the usb in the charging cable is a little loose but still works, there is also very minor cosmetic damage (pictured). 

Shutter Count: 9466

If you have any questions about this item, please do not hesitate to get in touch! Thank you for looking at this listing, I am selling some other lens so please check out my others listings too! :)

Features: 
40.2-MEGAPIXEL SENSOR Experience the greatest quality from X Series to date, with the incredible resolution of X-T5’s fifth-generation sensor. In Pixel Shift mode, produce 160MP stills.

X-PROCESSOR 5 X Series’ latest processor delivers a significant speed boost, doubling its predecessor’s capabilities. Autofocus, shutter speed and readout all see improvements

FULLY FEATURED With seven-stop IBIS, weather resistance, deep learning AF technology, professional video capabilities and more, X-T5 comfortably covers all creative bases.

CREATE ANYWHERE Utilise X-T5’s incredible potential near or far, thanks to a 557g body that’s even more compact than the portable X-T4.

VERSATILE FOCAL LENGTH With full-frame equivalent coverage of 27-84mm, subjects from virtually all genres can be photographed without ever swapping optics.

FEATURE-STACKED XF18-55mmF2.8-4 is no ordinary kit lens. Its variable aperture is respectively fast at the wide and long ends, plus there’s optical stabilisation and a linear AF motor.

Following closely in the footsteps of FUJIFILM X-H2, X-T5 marks the second X Series camera to exceed 40 megapixels. With a stripped-back, stills-focused form factor, creative potential is broader than ever. When it comes to image quality, Fujifilm’s signature analogue filmic look is retained, with an astounding level of added detail. Should more ever be needed, simply engage Pixel Shift Multi-Shot mode for 160-megapixel images.

The back-illuminated sensor is joined by X-Processor 5, combining to enable a host of exceptional features. A previously extended ISO 125 is now native, while shutter speeds extend to 1/180,000 sec. Even in the brightest conditions, fast apertures remain in play.

In more dimly lit settings, or for rapid handheld photography, seven-stops of IBIS are sure to mean fewer missed frames. XF18-55mmF2.8-4 adds further stops of OIS, activated by a switch on the barrel. Despite the five-axis stabilising structure, X-T5’s size and weight remain conveniently low. In fact, it’s smaller than its predecessor and weighs just 557g. The lens, too, is exceptionally lightweight for its focal range, tipping the scales at 310g. Tactile, external controls and programmable buttons are present on the camera body, as ever – joined by a 3.69 million dot EVF and 1.84 million dot, three-way tilting LCD. It’s even ruggedly weather sealed.

Creation is supported further by cutting-edge deep learning technology. Automatic white balance has seen a significant boost in accuracy – as has autofocus performance. A wide range of subjects, including faces, animals and vehicles, can be detected and tracked without disruption. In AF-S mode, high-frequency targets are easier to lock onto than ever. XF18-55mmF2.8-4’s linear, motor-driven AF system pushes potential further still.

While some post-production work is a crucial part of any advanced image maker’s process, a streamlined workflow is never amiss. Advanced X-T5 features, like Smooth Skin Effect, complete essential post steps in-camera. There are also 19 Film Simulation modes to choose from, including Nostalgic Neg., for gorgeous JPEGs – though HEIF image format is also available, for 10-bit quality in a 30% smaller file.

Despite a stills focus, X-T5’s video capabilities are nothing less than professional. Hybrid or dedicated video creatives can rely upon 6.2K 30P internal recording, in 4:2:2 10-bit colour. When less is more, try oversampled 4K HQ footage. There’s also a new F-Log2 with 13+ stops of dynamic range and 12-bit Apple ProRes RAW external recording.
